what.text: Tongkat ali is the root of Eurycoma longifolia, a Southeast Asian plant also called Malaysian ginseng. It is used in traditional medicine and marketed for stress, strength and testosterone. In rats, compounds from the root have shown aphrodisiac and testosterone effects.
In the US it is sold as a botanical dietary supplement. FDA does not review supplements before sale.

what.text: Tongkat ali is not an approved drug. Human trials are small and short.

research.text: Human studies of tongkat ali are small, short, and mostly from Malaysia, using standardized water extracts. A 2022 meta-analysis of 5 randomized trials found higher total testosterone with tongkat ali; a 2024 systematic review rated it “possibly” useful for testosterone in some groups.

research.title: Men with late-onset hypogonadism (Tambi et al.)

facts.v: open-label study with no placebo group
200 mg of a standardized water extract a day
Aging Males’ Symptoms score and serum testosterone

research.found: Symptom scores and testosterone improved. The share with normal testosterone went from 35.5% to 90.8%. With no placebo group, these changes cannot be separated from other causes.

research.title: Stress hormones and mood (Talbott et al.)

facts.v: salivary cortisol and testosterone; mood questionnaire

research.found: The tongkat ali group had lower tension, anger and confusion scores, 16% lower cortisol exposure and 37% higher salivary testosterone. The first author lists a supplement-information company as affiliation.

src.label: Talbott et al., J Int Soc Sports Nutr, 2013

research.title: Healthy young men, 2 weeks (Chan et al.)

facts.v: testosterone, free testosterone, estradiol, LH, FSH, SHBG

research.found: Testosterone, free testosterone and estradiol rose more than with placebo. LH, FSH and SHBG did not change.

research.title: Exercise and tongkat ali in aging men, 6 months (Leitão et al.)

facts.v: 45 men with androgen deficiency of aging, average age 47
200 mg tongkat ali or placebo, with or without exercise training three times a week
erectile function (IIEF-5), aging male symptoms, testosterone

research.found: Erectile function improved in both active arms, most with training plus tongkat ali. The trial had no tongkat-only-versus-training-only comparison, which the authors list as a limitation.

research.title: Total testosterone in men (Leisegang et al.)

facts.v: systematic review (9 studies) and meta-analysis (5 randomized trials)
healthy men and men with hypogonadism

research.found: Total testosterone was higher after tongkat ali (standardized mean difference 1.35). The authors said more research is needed before clinical use.

research.text: A 2024 systematic review of “testosterone booster” supplements found that most failed to raise total testosterone. It rated tongkat ali as “possibly effective” for men with late-onset hypogonadism and for healthy men, based on 3 studies.

us.text: Tongkat ali is sold in the US as a dietary supplement. It is not an FDA-approved drug, and FDA does not review supplements for safety or effectiveness before sale. As of November 1, 2026.

items.text: Tongkat ali is a botanical. Under US law, a product meant to supplement the diet that contains an herb or other botanical can be sold as a dietary supplement.

items.text: FDA does not have the authority to approve dietary supplements before they are marketed, and a firm generally does not have to give FDA its safety evidence. FDA does not approve supplements or their labelling.

side.text: The small trials report few side effects, but they were short. One published case report describes acute liver injury after tongkat ali.

items.text: a 47-year-old man developed jaundice and raised liver enzymes shortly after starting tongkat ali, and improved after stopping. The authors call it the first reported case.
in young men, estradiol rose along with testosterone over 2 weeks.
FDA does not review dietary supplements for safety before they are sold, so product contents and strength are not checked by FDA.
